text: For pilots, the ShortsOS team operates the workflow on the customer's behalf, from production through review to publication. In the one real run so far, publication went through a single Instagram account bound to the operating team. That run started from source video, went through a render and a human review, and ended with a live Instagram Reel whose permalink was captured. The workflow is not open for anyone to start alone: it runs as a pilot operated by the team.
